title: CPanel's Black Week: 3 New Vulnerabilities Patched After Attack on 44k Servers
summary: CPanel experienced a significant ransomware attack affecting approximately 44,000 servers during their Black Week promotional period, prompting the company to urgently patch three newly discovered security vulnerabilities in their widely-used web hosting control panel software.
problem_solved: Addresses critical security vulnerabilities in CPanel's server management software that were actively exploited during a ransomware campaign targeting shared hosting environments.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of timely security patching for widely-deployed hosting control panels and serves as a cautionary case study for web hosting providers and system administrators managing server infrastructure.
